entities.name: Boc-piperazine chromenone
observations: SELFIES-decoded substrate is a methoxy chromenone bearing a Boc-protected methylpiperazine and indazole-containing side chain.

entities.name: Deprotected piperazine chromenone
observations: Predicted product replaces the piperazine N-Boc group with N-H; the remaining scaffold is unchanged.
A close ORD match reports this deprotected piperazine product after Boc removal, in 97% yield over 2 hours.

entities.name: Piperazine Boc deprotection
observations: Acid-promoted removal of the Boc protecting group gives the free secondary piperazine nitrogen; close ORD record uses 1,4-dioxane and methylene chloride and reports 97% yield in 2 hours.
The supplied components decode to 1,4-dioxane, chloride, and chloroform; chloroform differs from methylene chloride in the close ORD record.
